build_LetterClassifier: build a LetterClassifier with a feature maker, encoder dimension, and letter count for CTC speech recognition
run_LetterClassifier_forward: run the LetterClassifier forward pass on raw audio input to get letter predictions
build_CTCLetterCriterion: build a CTCLetterCriterion with a letter classifier and letter count for computing CTC loss
run_CTCLetterCriterion_forward: run the CTCLetterCriterion forward pass with features, feature sizes, labels, and label sizes to compute loss
run_cut_data: run cut_data to trim a sequence tensor to its maximum length based on sequence lengths
